answer.summary: Two deterministic ArchUnit architecture rules fail, and both violations sit in files this change touched. TenantBackgroundTransactionArchTest flags intra-class self-invocation of @Transactional methods in CatalogListService and CatalogScenarioUpdateService, which bypasses the Spring proxy and the tenant scope. JsonTypeDirtyOnLoadCoverageTest fails because the JSON-mapped field probe list no longer matches the tenant-active tables. A re-run will fail the same way. The Jackson '<' parse error at line 1246 is unrelated noise from a mocked external service.
